rationale: Alon is building dexterous manipulation technology for humanoid robots using learning-based approaches, and Anvitha brings hands-on computer vision and robotics engineering experience from Athlitix—including object detection, tracking, and embedded vision work that directly complements manipulation systems. Her Python, C++, and MATLAB stack and background in assistive robotics align well with the technical depth needed to advance learning-from-demonstration approaches for complex hand tasks.
intro_message: Alon Ko, meet Anvitha Anchala — she's a CV engineer at Athlitix with robotics and vision systems experience that could strengthen Aora's work on robot manipulation and learning.
